description: Regenerate a source video from a prompt with the Cosmos 3 Super (64B) omni model.
inputInstructions:
Regenerates a source video using Cosmos3-Super. Select the source video as the input file; the prompt describes the output. For a structure-preserving transform driven by a control signal (edge, depth, segmentation), use the Control-Signal Transfer template instead.

This template consumes ONE input file, so run it from a workflow whose inputFileArity is 'one' or 'multi'. The built-in "NVIDIA Cosmos 3 Super (64B)" workflow takes no input files and serves the text-only templates.

Metadata this template reads (all optional; file metadata wins over asset metadata):
  COSMOS3_PROMPT           What to generate. Falls back to this when the Prompt field is blank.
  COSMOS3_NEGATIVE_PROMPT  What to avoid in the output.
  COSMOS3_SEED             Integer seed; the same seed reproduces the same generation.
  COSMOS3_GUIDANCE         How strictly to follow the prompt.
  COSMOS3_NUM_FRAMES       Number of frames to generate.

How to supply metadata: set these on the input FILE or on the ASSET (Metadata tab, or `vamscli metadata create`). Keys are case-sensitive.

Precedence: a value you type into a field above WINS. Metadata is used only where the field is left blank, so a standing value acts as a default.

Content safety: Disable content-safety guardrails ships CHECKED, so the NVIDIA guardrail models are skipped. They load alongside the generation model and need more GPU memory than the shipped instance types provide, so they are off by default for capacity reasons. Clear the field to run them, after raising the pipeline's instanceTypes to a larger GPU tier.
